Supreme Court to form panel on NEET protest police action

The Supreme Court announced it will form a high-powered committee to investigate allegations of police excesses against students during protests related to the NEET exam. The court's decision addresses concerns raised about the conduct of police during demonstrations. The committee's mandate is to probe these specific allegations of misconduct.
